Approval authority by grade

Advance requests and verified Expense Claims start with the immediate reporting manager and move through Reports To one person at a time. Linked reviewers are not skipped and nobody may approve their own request.

Advance authority is checked against the employee's live total outstanding advances. Expense Claim authority is checked only against the individual claim being reviewed.

Set the band on Employee → Grade. Designation remains the job title. Board of Directors has unlimited approval authority. Unlisted grades fall back to built-in defaults.
